notes.title: Kickstarter and demo coming soon
notes.notes:
Soon the church of stratum Prologue (which takes place 19 years before the events of the main game) will be released. After this the kickstarter for the project will go live. 

Be notified when the campaign launches to help support and get a full version of the game made, also get rewards for your support. So if you are interested in the game go sign up to be notified when the kickstarter launches.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tillion-23/church-of-stratum]Kickstarter coming soon page[/url]
